title: Armor and Weapon Generation for 2D Pixel Sprite Sheets?
author: Bones_6
selftext:
Has anyone figured out how to get consistent armor and weapon and other item generation for a 2D Pixel art style sprite sheet setup, similar to Stardew Valley or other similar style games?

I've tried going the Magenta route, where you generate a sprite sheet for a naked, hairless mannequin and then paint it magenta. Then upload that to ChatGPT or Nano Banana and have it generate clothes and armor on top of it. It gets CLOSE, but not quite close enough and it doesn't seamless come together when you load it into something like Godot.

comments.author: Chaibi_Alaa
comments.body: Meshy then you ask claude code to create a specific picture following an angle using blender

comments.author: Chologism
comments.body:
Takes an extra prompt. But what works for me

Give it your character and ask to generate it with the helmet

Then use that result and ask to remove the character 

You are left with just the fitting helmet

comments.author: Ok-Examination5484
comments.body:
You can use [spritesheets.ai](http://spritesheets.ai) for very high-quality spritesheets, which gives you the freedom to edit the generated spritesheet frame by frame or regenerate from a specific frame, generate assets, and combine with the spritesheet  
I advise you to check the tutorials page [https://www.spritesheets.ai/tutorial](https://www.spritesheets.ai/tutorial) , 5 minutes to help you understand the tool and make the most out of it
